emotions.line: It eliminates all diversions, it eliminates all emotions
stanza: The English motorway system is beautiful and strange
It's been there forever, it's never going to change
It eliminates all diversions, it eliminates all emotions
(All you got to do to stay alive is drive)

emotions.songTitle: Every Time the Sun Comes Up
stanza: Pace man for you
Hold my horses patient
Hey, man, tricks can wait
To heal my emotions

emotions.line: I forgot I was human as I laid up my emotions
stanza: With my wheels in a turning and my back to the window
I collected every wave from the shore
I forgot I was human as I laid up my emotions
And I knocked them like dishes to the floor

emotions.songTitle: In the Heat of the Summer
emotions.line: When compared to the angered emotions
stanza: Barricades sadly were risin'
Bricks were heavily flyin'
And the loudspeaker drowned like a whispering sound
When compared to the angered emotions
Ooh, darlin', when you're near me
And you tenderly call my name
I know that my emotions
Are somethin' I just can't tame
I've just got to have you, baby
Ah-ah-ah, ah-ah-ah, yeah

emotions.line: With the status of my emotions
stanza: With the status of my emotions
Oh, she says, "You're changing"
But we're always changing
It does not bother me to say

emotions.line: It's the combination that takes emotions
stanza: In the dark
On the way out
It's even in old songs
It's the combination that takes emotions
Why don't we go now?
No need to think on our own now about it

oceans.line: I've been out in front of a dozen dead oceans
stanza: Oh, where have you been, my blue-eyed son?
And where have you been, my darling young one?
I've stumbled on the side of twelve misty mountains
I've walked and I crawled on six crooked highways
I've stepped in the middle of seven sad forests
I've been out in front of a dozen dead oceans
I've been ten thousand miles in the mouth of a graveyard
I would swim oceans
I would move mountains
I would do anything for you
What do you want me to do?
